context: Pakistan's unemployment rate was 7.1% in 2024-25 (PBS Labour Force Survey, via Business Recorder).

cs.note: IT exports reached a record of about $4.6bn in FY2025-26 (+21%) and freelancers earned a record $1.76bn. Caution: entry-level IT hiring was reported down about 25% in Sep 2026.
sources: SBP data via Express Tribune (IT exports FY2025-26)

se.note: Same as Computer Science: record IT exports and freelancer earnings, but fewer entry-level openings in 2026.

ee.note: A PEC governing-body member said 150,000+ engineers were unemployed (2024); 5,946 engineers went abroad for jobs in 2025.

me.note: Same as Electrical: many unemployed engineers at home; steady demand abroad.

civil.note: Same as Electrical, plus a slowdown in construction.

mbbs.note: 3,795 doctors went abroad for jobs in 2025.

pharmd.note: Pharma exports hit a 20-year high of $457m in FY2025, then fell to about $319m in FY2026 after the Afghan trade disruption.
sources: PBS data via Asia News Network

nursing.note: The health minister reported a shortage of about 900,000 nurses (May 2026). Nurses working abroad grew about 54% a year from 2019 to 2024; international demand prefers female nurses.

fashion.note: Textile exports were flat at $17.93bn in FY2025-26 (+0.26%); readymade garments grew 3.87%.

bba.note: 11,777 managers went abroad for jobs in 2025.

af.note: 5,659 accountants went abroad for jobs in 2025.
